description_html:
<section aria-labelledby="courseDescription">
    Prerequisites: RS 2003, rehab major, senior standing, 2.00 cumulative grade point average, and consent of the instructor. 

This is a twelve hour course. A full-time, one semester supervised internship in a rehabilitation or social services setting, either public or private. Emphasis will be placed on the student acquiring first-hand experience and entry level skills in practitioner roles such as case management, interviewing and counseling, and coordination of client services among the various community helping services. 

Note: The purchase of professional liability insurance is required.  A grade of C or better is required for Rehabilitation Science majors.
    
</section>
